capabilities: Sync the Hardcover library as one note per book with frontmatter metadata
Customize note templates, frontmatter properties and filename templates
Organize book notes into folders grouped by author and/or series
Filter which books sync by reading status and update only changed books
Preserve user-added note content below a delimiter during syncs
disambiguation: Not a book-cover or image tool; it syncs the Hardcover reading-tracker service into book notes.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; Hardcover API keys expire after 1 year; README warns to keep regular vault backups and states the plugin is not affiliated with Hardcover or Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull your book library, reading status, reviews and highlights from Hardcover into vault notes.

relations.evidence: Syncs your Hardcover library to your Obsidian vault, creating one note per book

summary: Library syncer that imports your Hardcover book collection into Obsidian as one note per book with metadata in frontmatter properties.
